# telnyx_display_identity_record_infringement_update (Action)

Resolves an infringement concern on a DIR: certifies ownership, explains the resolution and optionally changes the display name, logo, call reasons or documents.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certify_brand_is_accurate` (Boolean) Must be `true`.
- `certify_ip_ownership` (Boolean) Must be `true`.
- `certify_no_infringement` (Boolean) Check to certify that the brand no longer infringes anyone else's trademark or intellectual property.
- `certify_no_shaft_content` (Boolean) Must be `true`.
- `dir_id` (String) The dir id.
- `infringement_resolution_notes` (String) Explanation of how the infringement concern was addressed.

### Optional

- `call_reasons` (List of String)
- `display_name` (String) The business name shown to call recipients, 1 to 35 characters, no emoji, not blank.
- `documents` (Attributes List) Append-only supporting documents to attach while resolving the claim (e.g. authorization or licensing proof). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documents))
- `logo_url` (String) Publicly accessible HTTPS URL (max 128 chars) to a 256x256 BMP logo (max 1 MB).

<a id="nestedatt--documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `documents`

Required:

- `document_id` (String) Id returned by the Telnyx Documents API after you upload the file (upload via `POST /v2/documents`; see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents).
- `document_type` (String) Type of supporting document. Pick the closest match to what the file actually contains; `other` triggers manual vetting and may slow approval. The matching short_name reference list is at `GET /v2/dir/document_types`. One of `articles_of_incorporation`, `bank_reference_letter`, `bank_statement`, `business_credit_report`, `business_license`, `business_registration`, `certificate_of_good_standing`, `ein_letter`, `government_id`, `letter_of_authorization`, `other`, `professional_license`, `tax_document`, `trademark_registration`, `utility_bill`, `website_ownership`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) An optional note describing this document, for example what it proves.
